source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
Once per turn, right after an enemy unit has finished attacking, this model may use this ability if those attacks cost at least 1 wound to any friendly **NECRON WARRIORS** unit 3" or less from it.

If it does, pick 1 such **NECRON WARRIORS** unit to activate its [Reanimation Protocols](vsdata:ability/necrons.reanimation-protocols). Each **NECRON WARRIORS** unit can be picked only once per turn.

detail.trigger: just after an enemy unit's attacks, if a friendly NECRON WARRIORS unit within 3 inches lost a wound to them
